newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish mostly higher.

text.p: March 18 - IMM currency futures finished mostly higher, with marks and Swiss francs ending near session highs. Traders attributed gains to technical short-covering, and noted that both currencies ignored bearish comments throughout the day. U.S. Feb consumer prices at 0830 EST/1330 GMT on Wed are seen rising 0.2 pct overall and in the core rate. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
